jikan.title: Bronze: Kouji Nanjo Cathexis
jikan.synopsis:
As an incredibly popular musician, Kouji Nanjou has released numerous music videos to promote his work. Despite his desire to avoid unnecessary probing from the media, he cannot help but reveal a glimpse into his obsession with Takuto Izumi.
